# zlib 1.3.2

These files are the unmodified compression sources from zlib 1.3.2. The
upstream archive is `https://zlib.net/fossils/zlib-1.3.2.tar.gz`, SHA-256
`bb329a0a2cd0274d05519d61c667c062e06990d72e125ee2dfa8de64f0119d16`.
The zlib license and copyright notice are included at the top of `zlib.h`.
Only the files needed by the experimental raw-DEFLATE adapter are copied here.
